findings.message: The largest embedded CSS template exceeds 500 KB; live timing and visual contracts are required before changing style delivery.
9 observer registrations use subtree:true (7 locally resolved and 2 cross-function); ownership and callback evidence are required before narrowing or merging them.
2 resolved registrations lack an AST-visible disconnect, runtimeTrackObserver or observer-registry signal and require manual lifecycle verification.
3 .observe() calls could not be linked to a constructor by local AST ownership and remain manual-review items.
